title: Stress-test your hashing intuition
prompt: Walk me through what happens to a hash table's load factor and average lookup time as I insert past 0.7, and how resizing + rehashing fixes it. Then quiz me with three increasingly hard questions and grade my answers.

title: Design a cache for a real workload
prompt: I have a read-heavy API with a Zipfian access pattern. Help me choose a cache size and eviction policy, predict the hit rate, and design an experiment to validate it in production.
